title: Pure Stygian
summary: Tetsu Trudge's Stygian DARK Fiend Synchro build, supported by the Tour Guide, Fiendish Rhino Warrior, and Archfiend Heiress engine. Stygian Street Patrol banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon a Fiend with 2000 or less ATK from the hand, pairing with Level 1 Fiend Tuner Stygian Security to Synchro Summon Stygian Sergeants.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tour Guide From the Underworld Special Summons Fiendish Rhino Warrior or Archfiend Heiress from the Deck to Link Summon Muckraker From the Underworld.
Fiendish Rhino Warrior sends Stygian Street Patrol or Archfiend Heiress from your Deck to the GY when sent to the GY, and Archfiend Heiress searches Infernity Archfiend (an 1800 ATK Level 4 Fiend).
Dark Grepher (searchable via Reinforcement of the Army) discards Stygian Street Patrol to send Stygian Security from your Deck to the GY.
One for One Special Summons Level 1 Stygian Security from the Deck, and Foolish Burial sends Stygian Street Patrol or Fiendish Rhino Warrior to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Tour Guide From the Underworld
steps: Normal Summon Tour Guide From the Underworld to Special Summon Fiendish Rhino Warrior from the Deck, then Link Summon Muckraker From the Underworld.
Trigger Fiendish Rhino Warrior in the GY to send Stygian Street Patrol (or Archfiend Heiress) from the Deck to the GY.

Discard or send a card with Muckraker to revive Stygian Security, banish Stygian Street Patrol from the GY to Special Summon a Level 4 Fiend (Infernity Archfiend or another Street Patrol) from your hand, and tune Level 1 Security with the Level 4 Fiend into Level 5 Stygian Sergeants.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Stygian Sergeants gains 800 ATK (reaching 3000 ATK) until the end of the Battle Phase and attacks a second time in a row whenever it destroys an opposing monster by battle.
Hundred Eyes Dragon (Level 1 Stygian Security + Level 4 Street Patrol + Level 3 Tour Guide or Rhino) banishes a Level 6 or lower DARK Effect Monster from your GY to copy its effects.
Void Ogre Dragon negates a Spell or Trap activation once per turn while your hand is empty, and Chaos Angel banishes a card on summon using your Level 5 Synchros or DARK Fiends.
Muckraker From the Underworld revives Stygian Security or Stygian Sergeants from the GY each turn while locking you into Fiends.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Stygian Dirge continuously reduces the Levels of all monsters your opponent controls by 1, throwing off their Synchro, Xyz, and Ritual Level math.
One for One turns a Stygian Street Patrol in hand into both a discarded Street Patrol in the GY and a Level 1 Stygian Security on the field for an immediate Level 5 Synchro.

main: Stygian Street Patrol

Signature Level 4 DARK Fiend (1600 ATK / 1200 DEF): inflicts burn damage equal to a destroyed monster's Level x 100 on battle destruction; and banishes itself from your GY to Special Summon 1 Fiend monster with 2000 or less ATK from your hand!
Stygian Security

Signature Level 1 DARK Fiend Tuner (100 ATK / 600 DEF): required Fiend Tuner for Stygian Sergeants (Level 1 Security + Level 4 Street Patrol = Level 5 Stygian Sergeants!); when destroyed by battle and sent to the GY, Special Summons 1 Level 1 Fiend monster (another Stygian Security!) directly from your Deck!
Tour Guide From the Underworld
Core starter: Special Summons Fiendish Rhino Warrior from your Deck on Normal Summon; linking both into Muckraker triggers Rhino Warrior to send Stygian Street Patrol from your Deck to the GY!
Fiendish Rhino Warrior

Protects your Fiend monsters (including Stygian Sergeants and Stygian Security!) from battle and card effect destruction while on the field, and sends Stygian Street Patrol or Archfiend Heiress from your Deck to the GY when sent to the GY.
Archfiend Heiress
When sent to the GY by Fiendish Rhino Warrior or Muckraker's discard, adds 'Infernity Archfiend' from your Deck to your hand (to be Special Summoned from your hand by Stygian Street Patrol!).
Infernity Archfiend

Level 4 DARK Fiend (1800 ATK): Special Summoned from your hand by banishing Stygian Street Patrol from your GY, providing the exact Level 4 non-Tuner alongside Level 1 Fiend Tuner Stygian Security to Synchro Summon Level 5 Stygian Sergeants (and searches another copy if summoned with 0 cards in hand)!
Dark Grepher
Limited to 1 in TCG: discards Stygian Street Patrol to send Stygian Security from your Deck to the GY (so Muckraker can revive Security to tune with a Level 4 into Stygian Sergeants!).
One for One

Limited to 1 in TCG: discards Stygian Street Patrol to Special Summon Level 1 Stygian Security directly from your Deck—then banishing the discarded Street Patrol summons a Level 4 Fiend from your hand for an instant Level 5 Stygian Sergeants!
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Stygian Street Patrol or Fiendish Rhino Warrior from your Deck to the GY.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Dark Grepher.
Stygian Dirge
Signature Continuous Trap: reduces the Levels of ALL monsters your opponent controls by 1—completely disrupting your opponent's Synchro Summon, Xyz Summon, and Ritual Summon Level calculations!
extra: Signature Level 5 DARK Fiend Synchro boss (1 Fiend-Type Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters: Level 1 Stygian Security + Level 4 Stygian Street Patrol / Infernity Archfiend; 2200 ATK): when this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY, it gains 800 ATK (to 3000 ATK!) until the end of the Battle Phase AND can make a second attack in a row!

Level 8 DARK Dragon Synchro (1 DARK Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Fiend monsters: Level 1 Stygian Security + Level 4 Street Patrol + Level 3 Tour Guide/Rhino; 3000 ATK) that banishes a DARK monster from your GY to copy its effect.
Level 10 Synchro boss (made with Level 5 Stygian Sergeants + another Level 5 or Level 4 + 3 + 3 DARK non-Tuners!) that banishes a card on Summon.
Link-2 DARK Fiend: links off Tour Guide + Fiendish Rhino Warrior (dumping Stygian Street Patrol from Deck!), then discards 1 card to revive Stygian Security or Stygian Sergeants from your GY!
Level 8 Synchro: negates and destroys an opponent's Spell or Trap activation once per turn while your hand is empty.
